nodes.name: AI: Policy Check & VIP Margin Audit (JSON)

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ model: 'gpt-4o-mini', temperature: 0.0, response_format: { type: 'json_object' }, messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are a CRM pre-send QA auditor. Fixed checks (merge-tag fallbacks, links, UTMs, unsubscribe tag, subject length, preview text, alt text) are already done by code: do not repeat them. Check only two things against the store policy: (1) copy claims the store cannot keep (e.g. a shipping time when published_shipping_sla is none, an expiry window on a static code), category policy_mismatch; (2) a discount or coupon offered while excluded_segments lacks the required VIP, recent-buyer and CX-hold exclusions, category vip_margin_guard. Return strictly JSON: has_discount_offer (bool), blockers (array of {category, issue, fix}), warnings (array of {category, issue, fix}).' }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify({ draft: $('Form / Webhook: Submit Campaign Draft').item.json.body, policy: $json }) } ] }) }}

nodes.notes: Temperature 0.0, JSON only. The AI gets only the judgment calls: copy against store facts, and discount exclusions.
